sources.title: Meridian Water - proposed bus changes
sources.verified_claim: TfL published its decision to proceed with bus-network changes supporting Meridian Water, phased alongside construction and occupation of new homes.

sources.title: Emergency action to kickstart London housebuilding
sources.verified_claim: Government says the New Homes Accelerator unlocked a 4,000-home Beam Park regeneration site, released 1,500 homes behind a planning condition and confirmed the proposed station can be accommodated on the existing rail network while funding is assembled.

sources.title: 365 Bus
sources.verified_claim: The Mayor states extension of route 365 to planned Beam Park station is only a possible future option and depends on a developer-provided bus stand, highway changes and consultation; timescales are not confirmed.

sources.title: Infrastructure in regeneration
sources.verified_claim: Havering identifies Beam Parkway as complementary infrastructure for Rainham and Beam Park, with walking and cycling links connecting new development to facilities and transport hubs.

sources.title: Vauxhall
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth describes Vauxhall as a major regeneration area with nearly 3,500 new homes and 8,000 jobs and transport investment including the Northern Line Extension.

sources.title: Major highways schemes
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth identifies Vauxhall Cross as a critical enabling project for access to the VNEB growth area and Waterloo City Hub as a major junction/public-realm intervention.

sources.title: Waterloo regeneration activity
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states Waterloo anticipates 6,000 new jobs and 1,500 new homes, with station masterplanning, public-realm and movement projects underway or planned.
